title: Microsoft Purview: OCR scanning of images for DLP in SharePoint and OneDrive (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, documented controls and consumption pricing are supported. Minor corrections should complete the control paths and disclose Microsoft's differing TIFF billing, image-size and insider-risk preview descriptions; government-cloud defaults and release-specific billing remain unstated.
